learning: No race yet. Next iteration: if max_error or line_loss_events is high on the s-bend or slalom, raise kp or widen the sensor span; if steering_oscillation is high, lower kp or raise kd; if completion_time is above 3 s, raise base_speed.
notes: Baseline five-sensor package with sensor weights proportional to x, kp 2.5, small ki and kd, base_speed 1.6 and last_direction line-loss recovery. Built to run the Builder's geometry unchanged so the first race isolates the geometry.
rationale: This is iteration 0, so there is no race telemetry yet. The Builder's baseline geometry is valid against the public contract: five sensors at x = -0.02 to 0.02 m, y = 0.05 m, sensor_size 0.012, wheel_track 0.12, wheel_radius 0.03, body_width 0.12, body_length 0.18, mass 0.6. I keep it unchanged so the first race tests the geometry itself. The signal is the reading-weighted average of the weights, and positive signal steers left. Sensors on the left (positive x) therefore get positive weights, and the weights are set proportional to x as [-2,-1,0,1,2]. A robot drifting left sees the line under right-hand sensors, gets a negative signal, and steers right, which is the correct sign. Each unit of signal adds kp*350 PWM of differential, so kp = 2.5 gives about 875 PWM at full signal, a moderate authority that avoids saturating on a 2-unit signal. ki is small (0.05) to remove steady bias from the motor mismatch without winding up. kd is small (0.05) because the sensor overlap is smooth but the 10 ms signal derivative can amplify noise. base_speed 1.6 gives base PWM of about 3276 (80% of full), which leaves headroom for turn differential at full correction. line_loss is 'last_direction', so the robot keeps turning the way it was going when the line is lost, which suits bends better than a fixed search direction. I expect the oval and s-bend to finish, with the slalom the most likely place to show line loss or oscillation. Observation request covers completion, progress, time, rms and max error, line-loss events, oscillation and controller errors so the Builder gets full evidence.
